newsitem.title: USA: IMF postpones mission to Ecuador - sources.
newsitem.headline: IMF postpones mission to Ecuador - sources.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund mission to Ecuador to continue an annual review of economic conditions has been postponed because of political upheavals in the country, monetary sources said Friday.

Earlier, Ecuador's defense minister declared a nationwide state of emergency in an attempt to help quell protests against President Abdala Bucaram, who was ousted by Congress on Thursday but has refused to step down.
"It is my understanding that the mission was been delayed," one source said.

During the now-delayed discussions of the country's economic health, the IMF had considered the possibility of beginning very early talks on a new economic program for Ecuador but this was far from certain, the sources said.
The IMF reviews the economic condition of each member-country on an annual basis.
